name: Forno Acqua MultiSINK Stainless Steel 33" Dual Mount Double Bowl Sink with Waterfall Faucet
shortDescription: The MultiSINK Offset + Waterfall Faucet brings sculptural rinsing and space-saving design to the heart of your kitchen. Its offset layout features a large main bowl and slim center divider for multitasking ease, while the removable Drying Deck clears clutter and opens up the basin when you need it most. The pivoting faucet delivers a graceful waterfall stream, with a lever-controlled 4-mode spray head offering stream, spray, power wash, and waterfall versatility. Roll-up grids create a flat prep surface, making this sink a true workstation for modern cooking. Dual-mount installation and cUPC certification ensure lasting quality and universal fit.
